requirements.text: Patients should be able to book, cancel, or reschedule appointments online.
There should be a simple online form for requesting repeat prescriptions, with confirmation and estimated readiness time.
Patients must securely access their test results after clinician review, with clear explanations and options for follow-up.
An online questionnaire should be available for patients to flag urgent symptoms for same-day appointments, with immediate review by the team.
Integration with existing practice management software is essential.
The portal must enhance patient access and experience while reducing the workload on reception staff.
The system must comply with data protection regulations.
The interface must be user-friendly, especially for those who may not be as comfortable with technology.
